Mishi

Painter & Storyteller • UK

The Artist Behind the Canvas

"Art is how we tether fleeting emotions to a permanent canvas."

Based in the United Kingdom, Mishi creates delicate, atmospheric fine art combining traditional watercolor, gouache, oils, and 24k gold leaf.

Every original painting and archival print is crafted to bring stillness, warmth, and enduring beauty into your home.

Preservation

How to Care for Your Art

1

Framing & Glazing

Always use acid-free mounting tape and archival matting. We recommend UV-filtering Artglass to preserve pigments.

2

Lighting & Humidity

Avoid direct prolonged sunlight, radiators, or damp bathrooms.

3

Deckled Edges

When handling original cotton paper or silk tassel bookmarks, hold by the edges with clean dry hands.
